message.content:
This magazine cover features the title "TEMPO" in large, gray capital letters above a date of "16-22 MARET 2015". Smaller text at the top reads "MINYAKSONANGOL TANPA DISKON" and "ISTANA DAN DUA BERINGIN".

The illustration displays a man viewed from the back, wearing a red long-sleeved shirt, a dark cap, a checkered scarf, and a green belt. He stands at a dark brown podium, holding a wooden gavel aloft. He faces rows of seated figures wearing dark suits. These figures have gray, featureless heads resembling crash-test dummies with circular markings on their temples. One seated figure on the left holds up a red circular sign with the white number "012". A black microphone stands on the podium.

The background is a flat, hazy gray. Large white text in the lower left corner reads "AHOK VS DPRD" and "ARISAN PROYEK SILUMAN". A barcode, price "RP 39.500", and other publishing details are at the bottom. A solid red border runs along the left edge.
